GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Drifted Back 2nd last Two Wide 8 Lengths 800m, came widest soon after Straightening Up but well off them, Made Good Ground last 200m and grabbed minor placing # grabbed placing
Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down last 10 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to Turn then Hooked Out to 7 Lengths 3 Wide , got no wider and Made Ground through field in Straight # back/ran on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When under pressure in the straight, laid in and passing the 50m, brushed another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Not Bustled Settled Down Off Mid-Field Inside 7 Lengths then 8 Lengths , Under Pressure x Turn clear run home - # couldn't quicken
Jumped only fairly, slow into stride & Settled Down 6 Lengths on fence, railed to 4 Lengths turning, Held Up home turn to the 100m, then Made Some Ground 2-3 Wide in Straight # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow into stride. Held up for clear running from approaching the 300m until passing the 100m. Over the concluding stages was steadied and then awkwardly placed close on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly, slow into stride & Settled Down last of eight runners but only 6 Lengths from the lead, Drifted Back to 7.5 Lengths rail turning, shifted Two Wide rounding turn, fanned out widest Straightening Up and Made Some Ground down the outside in Straight # back/battled fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow into stride. Near the 300m laid in close to heels and eased.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length then very slow into stride, Settled Down a long, solitary last 11 Lengths from the lead, tacked on middle stages, last trailing 6 Lengths turning, hooked widest rounding turn, out past centre of track Straightening Up and Made Ground down the outside in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. App. jockey explained her instructions were to help it begin and settle midfield however it began only fairly and she elected to settle rearward. Trainer confirmed instructions and was surprised to see it So far back.] # very slow early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Laid in under pressure in the straight. Tactics queried.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased then hampered & Settled Down last but only trailing 5 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, ridden along at 400m, swung widest Straightening Up but made little headway in straight. [Stewards: Rider reported that the race tempo did not suit it after beginning only fairly and being hampered and settling further back than intended.] # no real excuses
Jumped okay & Went Forward to Two Wide joint Lead settling down, Headed 1250m, Drifted Back to 3 Lengths Two Wide turning, Made Some Ground in Straight # battled on fairly

Jumped okay & Settled Down Mid Field 6.5 Lengths on fence, Checked 1000m, railed to 5 Lengths turning, Held Up 400m-200m, squeezed between runners 160m, Made Some Ground to the line but never gathered sufficient momentum to be a threat # no luck in Straight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at the start. Checked and contacted the rail near the 1000m. Held up for a run from the 400m until approaching the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4 Lengths on fence, little change to 4.5 Lengths turning, blocked rounding home turn and early in straight, Two Wide at 400m, 3 Wide Straightening Up , around heels at 250m, ran on hitting Lead 40m from post # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Had difficulty obtaining clear running round home turn and in the early part of the home straight. Rdr dropped whip inside the final 100m after being struck by whip of another rider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 7 Lengths Two Wide turning, Made Some Ground along rail in Straight # Had its chances
Tightened on jumping then dipped (-1 length), Settled Down 6.5 Lengths on fence, railed to 5.5 Lengths turning, made a little ground in Straight # slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After the start, tightened for room between runners and dipped.
